newsitem.title: GERMANY: German bourse says pricing system disrupted.
newsitem.headline: German bourse says pricing system disrupted.

text.p: The price information system on the Frankfurt bourse was briefly disrupted on Friday afternoon, but trading continued throughout, the stock exchange said.
The disruption, which affected price information for some 45 minutes, struck in early afternoon electronic trade and ended at 1346 GMT.
A bourse spokesman said there was a problem with the Frankfurt ticker system which affected share price transmission.
